text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with 
Nakayama Festa, I was invited into a 
clothing store, but—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...This one looks pretty good. Hey, go 
try it on."
choice_data_list: Huh, you want me to wear it?
Wait, I'm wearing it?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's right. Go knock 'em dead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What I tried on was a white jacket with a 
sleek silhouette. It was an unfamiliar 
design, leaving me feeling restless...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, stop looking around. Look into my 
eyes... and don't look away.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't slouch your shoulders like that, 
puff your chest out a bit. Raise your chin 
a little—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—Heh, you're actually looking the part. 
Alright, let's move.
choice_data_list: Huh, g-go where...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it, it's just a little 
showdown.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...You'll see when you get there. Stand 
tall and confident.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Here it is... It's my usual ramen shop, 
but I haven't shown my face here for a 
reason—

text_block_list.name: Rough-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, well look who it is—Nakayama! Been a 
while since I've seen your face...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"—And well, that's how it is. Can't even 
eat my meal in peace."

text_block_list.name: Rough-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Like that's your style! You 
don't care about anything unless it's a 
crazy showdown, right?

text_block_list.name: Rough-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna pay you back in full today for 
all the times I lost to you before, 
Nakayama!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The man edged closer and closer to 
Nakayama Festa. Without hesitation, I 
stepped in between her and the man.
choice_data_list: ...Could you just leave me alone?

text_block_list.name: Rough-Looking Man
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Who the hell are you—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Don't look away, don't slouch your 
shoulders, chest out, chin up slightly—"
choice_data_list: I won't say it twice.

text_block_list.name: Rough-Looking Man
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh! —Who the hell are you!?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I haven't introduced you yet. This is my 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rough-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!? Hah... Any way you look at it, 
they're clearly on "our side"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We can't let our guard down yet. Push back 
the opponent with sheer willpower...!

text_block_list.name: Rough-Looking Man
text_block_list.text: ……Got it. Sorry for bothering you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Heheh... Ah-hahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I've had a lot of history with the folks 
around here in the past, but... I've never 
seen them make that kind of face before... 
Heheh.
choice_data_list: We still have a race after this, huh...

We still have a race after this, don't 
we...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hm? The match is already over. And I won 
by betting on you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...What I bet on was whether I could 
ditch the guy trying to mess with me 
before we even started competing."
choice_data_list: So that's how it was...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I trained you for that, didn't I? 
...Off-board tactics, bluffs, the guts to 
dive in. The outcome was decided before it 
even started.
choice_data_list: If I was able to help, that's great!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, don't get ahead of yourself. We're 
still in the lion's den here.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Let what's inside you bleed through. Keep 
it honed at all times.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...If you intend to stand by my side from 
here on out.
choice_data_list: ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... I'll invite you if I feel like it. 
Whenever I want to eat in peace, that 
is...
choice_data_list: Leave it to me anytime.

When push comes to shove, I'll fight 
too...
Now that you mention it, I'm starving!
Now that you mention it, I'm starving!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... I'll invite you if I feel like it. 
Whenever I want to eat in peace, that 
is...
choice_data_list: Leave it to me anytime.

When push comes to shove, I'll fight 
too...
Now that you mention it, I'm starving!
Now that you mention it, I'm starving!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That's reassuring. There are a few other 
shops around here that are hard to get 
into.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Soba shops, okonomiyaki joints... The 
food's good, but they're all infested with 
folks I've got bad blood with.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I just hope your bluff is enough to make 
them back down quietly.
choice_data_list:
We'll cross that bridge when we come to 
it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... Hahahaha! Now you're starting 
to look like a true gambler!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help but laugh along with 
Nakayama Festa. And as our conversation 
blossomed, we took our time enjoying the 
delicious food!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment I answered— I felt the eyes of 
everyone in the shop piercing my back.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I told you, we're still in the lion's den. 
...Well, not like anyone's gonna challenge 
the current you, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I answered casually, but it seemed to have 
made things needlessly tense. ...I feel 
bad about that.
choice_data_list:
If you'd like, shall we all make a toast 
together?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, and you've got the capacity to 
match?! Looks like I've crafted one hell 
of a monster...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And once we toasted, the whole shop got 
rowdy. When I apologized to Nakayama Festa 
for making so much noise, she just laughed 
and forgave me!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, you were on edge just a second 
ago and now you've already got an 
appetite?
choice_data_list:
Compared to before the race, this is 
nothing.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, no doubt about it! They're not even 
in the same league!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The regulars suddenly grew rowdy. They 
seemed to be chattering among themselves, 
saying things like, "Is that world really 
that crazy?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Looks like every single one of 'em is 
intrigued. —It's a thrilling world out 
there, ain't it?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If you're curious, come on over and watch. 
I won't let you down... Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I give a firm nod, Nakayama Festa 
flashes a fearless grin!
